performance_and_latency_benchmark.order_frequency_context: At most 1 order per 5m to 15m candle bar interval
performance_and_latency_benchmark.performance_impact: Negligible. ~24ms latency is <0.01% of the candle bar interval.

durability_tradeoff_analysis.protection_level: Host power-loss safe, hypervisor termination safe, application crash safe
durability_tradeoff_analysis.fsync_behavior: SQLite explicitly executes fsync() / FlushFileBuffers on every WAL commit
durability_tradeoff_analysis.limitations: Does not protect against physical disk storage controller failure or hardware bad blocks
